name: Halftone
doc: AM CMYK screens at 15/75/0/45 degrees forming rosettes, dot gain, a little slip.

p.f:
out = paper; cell = 6.0
for cov, ink, ang, (dy, dx) in zip((c, m, y, k), [array([0, 164, 228])/255, array([232, 18, 130])/255, array([255, 230, 0])/255, array([38, 34, 36])/255], (15, 75, 0, 45), ((-1.5, -1), (1.5, 0.5), (0, 1.5), (0, 0))):
    a = deg2rad(ang); u = (xx*cos(a)+yy*sin(a))/cell; v = (-xx*sin(a)+yy*cos(a))/cell
    spot = 0.5*(cos(2*pi*u)+cos(2*pi*v))
    cc = clip(cov*1.08, 0, 1)
    dot = sig((spot - (1-2*cc))*7.0)*(cc > 0.02)
    dot = gaussian(dot, 0.45)
    dot = ndi.shift(dot, (dy, dx), order=1, mode='nearest')
    out = out*(1 - dot[..., None]*(1-ink[None, None]))
